question: Amarsimha was one of the luminaries in the court of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandragupta II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amarsimha** was one of the luminaries in the court of **Chandragupta II**.
 
• Amarasimha was a renowned Sanskrit poet and grammarian who flourished in the court of Chandragupta II, commonly referred to as **Vikramaditya**, around **375 AD**.
 
• He holds a distinguished place among the nine "gems" adorning Chandragupta II's throne, collectively known as **Navratna**.
 
• Chandragupta II, the third ruler of the Gupta Empire in India, pursued the expansionist approach initiated by his father, Samudragupta, predominantly through military conquests.
 
• Historical records indicate his victories over the Western Kshatrapas, which led to the extension of the Gupta Empire from the Indus River in the west to the Bengal region in the east, and from the foothills of the Himalayas in the north to the Narmada River in the south.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Kumaragupta I**, an emperor of the Gupta Empire in Ancient India, was the son of Emperor Chandragupta II and Queen Dhruvadevi. He appears to have effectively governed the territory inherited from his father, which stretched from Gujarat in the west to the Bengal region in the east.
 
• **Chandragupta I,** a monarch of the Gupta Empire, ruled over northern and central India. His title, Maharajadhiraja, suggests that he was the inaugural emperor of the dynasty.
 
• **Samudragupta, **the second emperor of the Gupta Empire in ancient India, is esteemed as one of the greatest rulers of the country's history.
